t: The LAP 3m HDMI cable provides extended reach for professional AV and IT setups, supporting HDMI 2.1 performance with 48 Gbps bandwidth for clear 8K resolution. A reinforced copper core and gold-plated connectors maintain stable signal transfer across longer runs. The round black PVC sheath offers a durable finish suited to indoor environments, while unshielded construction keeps the profile flexible for routing in tight spaces.
